archetypes.rule: k-means (k=3,5) on as-of trait vectors fit on TRAIN rows only; archetype dummies appended to the selected feature level; adopted only if the validation log score improves by >= 1e-4 nats AND the development log score improves with p < 0.10 and >= 1e-3 nats/opportunity

end_to_end_development.label: DEVELOPMENT end-to-end (2025 + 2026 wk1-3; burned, not holdout)

receiving_with_air_archetypes.note: air-yard pmf refit with k=5 archetype dummies (adopted at component level); all else unchanged

defense_with_recalibrated_snaps.note: def_snap samples replaced by the validation-fit PIT recalibration (Phase 1A hardening item C); other inputs unchanged

comparators_not_reproduced.incumbent_production_projections: no distributional incumbent output exists in the development pipeline (the production champions emit point projections)
comparators_not_reproduced.phase_0B_decomposed: the Phase 0B oracle decomposition is an error-budget analysis on realized opportunities, not a pregame forecaster; it is not a comparator for a full pregame distribution

used.unit_availability: injury-report Out/Doubtful (+0.5 x Questionable) counts by unit from the historical final-weekly-report proxy (A2); positions from the static players table. No starter identities are reconstructed.

not_used_and_why.participation_offense_players / defense_: realized same-game participation (post-game); forbidden as a pregame input; also unpublished for 2026
not_used_and_why.snap_counts: realized same-game snaps; usable only as history through prior weeks
not_used_and_why.weekly_roster status: game-day snapshot (A3); T-90m only, and cannot identify offensive-line starters
not_used_and_why.depth_charts: timestamped snapshots exist for 2025+ (dt <= cutoff) and could give OL starters, but the tables carry no 2023-24 snapshots, so any OL-starter feature could only be fit on the 2025 development weeks (leaves nothing out-of-time); NOT used
not_used_and_why.ftn box / blitz (2026): FTN charting continues through 2026 and feeds the scheme profile through prior weeks only (via nfl_context_v4.def_profile)
not_used_and_why.man/zone, coverage, pressure (2026): participation is unpublished for 2026; def_profile falls back to the prior season for coverage-type rates (stale but as-of legal)

data_source_audit.limitation: OL quality (pass-block win rate, run-block grades) is not available from a timestamp-safe pregame source in this repository; the personnel family measures only reported absences.
